description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'NotRequired' validation rule within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract rule class and uses a trait to determine if an input is considered empty, implementing logic to mark a field as not required during validation.

classes.name: NotRequired
classes.description: A validation rule class that determines whether a given input is optional (not required) based on certain conditions. It can exclude empty strings from being considered valid, allowing for flexible validation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets whether empty strings should be excluded from validation as empty inputs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input, returning true if the input is considered not required based on the configuration.
